sovereign_country.strategic_role: 海湾阿拉伯国家自贸走廊、外资100%控股与印度洋海运枢纽

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Publishing of Simulated Social Casino and Virtual Slots Games

stage_1.document_name: Certified copy of the corporate Founder's Certificate of Incorporation/Commercial Registration (if shareholder is a legal entity)
stage_1.issuing_entity: Foreign company registry / authorized notary public in the Founder's domicile
stage_1.authentication_path: Consular Legalization — Oman is not a Contracting State to the 1961 Hague Apostille Convention; the document must be notarized, attested by the land Ministry of Foreign Affairs, then legalized by the Sultanate of Oman's Embassy/Consulate; subsequent certified Arabic translation.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Commercial Companies Law of the Sultanate of Oman, Royal Decree 18/2019 (as amended by Royal Decree 28/2022), Articles 1-12, 259-268 (Single Person Company); Foreign Capital Investment Law, Royal Decree 50/2019 (100% foreign ownership permitted for approved activities)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MoCIIP), Companies Registration Department – Invest Easy e-portal (investeasy.gov.om)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Commercial Registration (CR) with Notarized Model Articles of Association of the Single Person Company (Form SPC-01, Invest Easy transaction type: 'Incorporation of Single Person Company')
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital under RD 18/2019 for a Single Person Company; the sole shareholder must declare adequate capital proportionate to the digital publishing activity, fully pay it into a corporate bank account in Oman, and submit the bank capital advice certificate with the incorporation filing; no escrow account is required
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the sole shareholder hereby subscribes for and accepts 100% of the issued share capital of the Company as set forth in the Model Articles of Association, and that such capital shall be fully paid into the Company's corporate bank account prior to commencement of operations. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the registered office of the Company shall be the premises at [address], Muscat Governorate, Sultanate of Oman, duly notified to the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion. RESOLVED FURTHER, that [Name] is appointed as the first Manager of the Company, with full authority to execute incorporation filings, open banking facilities, and effect legal signatures on behalf of the Company until revoked. RESOLVED FURTHER, that all statutory declarations and registration documents are ratified.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: MoCIIP Companies Registration Department – Invest Easy e-portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Log into Invest Easy, select 'Name Reservation', enter three proposed names in Arabic (with Latin transliteration) consistent with SPC suffix ('(LLC) - Single Person Company'), verify ISIC 5820 scope description, and submit the reservation application with the shareholder's passport copy, then download the name approval certificate (valid 60 days).
required_dossiers: Valid passport copy of the sole foreign shareholder
Name reservation application form (e-form via Invest Easy)
Board/shareholder resolution appointing the formation representative (POA)
Notarized power of attorney if filing through a representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected for similarity or linguistic conflict, file an objection via Invest Easy within 10 working days, or resubmit with a new priority name; MoCIIP provides a reasoned rejection notice and allows free re-submission of alternative names.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Notarization of the Model Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public Office attached to the Court of First Instance in the Governorate of the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the Model Articles of Association based on the SPC template of RD 18/2019, incorporating the sole shareholder's details, capital amount, registered office address, and corporate objects restricted to publishing of simulated social casino and virtual slots games; appear before the Notary Public with the shareholder or lawful attorney to sign the Articles; obtain notarized Arabic original plus certified English translation.
required_dossiers: Name approval certificate from MoCIIP
Passport copies of the sole shareholder and appointed first Manager
Draft Model Articles of Association (Arabic)
Signed share subscription statement
Notarial appointment certificate for the attorney, if applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Notary issues a query, correct the capital adequacy clause or the lawful purpose wording, amend and re-submit the Articles; minor drafting objections are cured by executing an addendum resolution approved by the sole shareholder.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Commercial Registration Filing and CR Certificate Issuance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: MoCIIP Companies Registration Department – Invest Easy e-portal (Commercial Registration Module)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the 'Incorporation of Single Person Company' e-application attaching the notarized Articles, the validated lease/joint tenancy contract (registered at the municipality) for the Oman registered address, the bank capital deposit certificate, and identification of the first Manager; pay the statutory filing fee electronically and await issuance of the electronic Commercial Registration (CR) certificate bearing the CR number, company name, and ISIC 5820 activity code.
required_dossiers: Notarized Model Articles of Association
Name reservation approval certificate
Registered office lease contract (Ejari-style municipality registered)
Bank capital deposit advice certificate (for the Oman corporate account)
Passport copies of shareholder and Manager
No-objection letter from the Real Estate owner regarding commercial use
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is put on hold for document ambiguity, respond via the Invest Easy 'My Applications – Objection/Pending' channel within 10 working days, provide certified Arabic translations of foreign dossiers, and remedy any mismatch between the business scope and the SPC objects clause; the application is auto-resumed upon curing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Muscat Municipality – Business Licensing Department (or competent municipality of the registered office Governorate)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After CR issuance, apply for the Municipality Commercial Business License through the 'Balady' e-services portal, referencing the CR number, confirming the premises use classification as 'Digital Content Publishing Office – No Public Access', uploading the lease contract, CR certificate, and registered office layout plan; obtain the annual municipality license required to lawfully operate the registered premises.
required_dossiers: Commercial Registration certificate (CR)
Registered lease contract and ownership deed/title deed of premises
Premises floor plan and zoning compliance statement
Civil defense fire safety preliminary approval (office occupancy)
Passport-sized photos of the Manager
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If zoning or building compliance queries arise, obtain a supplementary architectural compliance letter from a licensed Omani engineer and re-submit via Balady; municipality queries may also be settled by narrowing the licensed activity wording to 'programming and electronic publishing services'.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registration with the Oman Chamber of Commerce and Industry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Oman Chamber of Commerce and Industry (OCCI) – Membership Department
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the OCCI membership application at the branch covering the registered office, submitting the CR certificate, municipality license, and passport copies of the Manager; pay the annual membership subscription; obtain the OCCI membership certificate which is a mandatory supporting document for opening corporate bank accounts and obtaining tax registration.
required_dossiers: Commercial Registration certificate (CR)
Municipality Commercial Business License
Valid lease contract of registered office
Manager's and shareholder's passport copies
Completed OCCI membership application form
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If OCCI rejects for inactive municipality record, verify the municipality license issuance date and re-apply after the municipality record is synchronized in the government 'Rakhyoot' data exchange; alternatively escalate to MoCIIP for inter-agency coordination.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable – ISIC 5820 social casino and virtual slots publishing is a purely digital/software activity with no physical manufacturing plant; no industrial establishment license is required under the Industrial Law (Royal Decree 72/2013)
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Municipality Commercial Business License for Digital Content Publishing (annual, renewable), issued by Muscat Municipality in addition to the Commercial Registration; no separate gaming license applies because the product uses no real-money wagering and is delivered exclusively through Apple App Store IAP and Google Play Billing

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Environment Authority of the Sultanate of Oman (EA Oman)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt – the activity generates no point-source industrial emissions, no hazardous waste, and no significant environmental footprint; only general electronic waste disposal (WEEE) obligations under the Waste Management Law (Royal Decree 17/2015) apply to office IT equipment
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No industrial wastewater discharge (office premises must comply with Muscat Municipality sewage connection standards); no VOC or stack emission thresholds triggered; IT equipment disposal must follow OMR 500+ e-waste segregation rules under EA Executive Regulation 80/2021; server hosting must use certified third-party data centers (e.g., Oman Data Park) compliant with cooling efficiency standards.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Public Authority for Civil Defence and Ambulance (PACDA) – mandatory fire safety certification for the registered office including smoke detectors, fire extinguishers, and emergency exit signage per PACDA Technical Standard 2018; Ministry of Labour workplace clearance confirming safe occupational conditions, rest areas, and workstation ergonomics for software development staff under Labour Law (Royal Decree 35/2003); general office structural load inspection certified by a licensed civil engineer is required only for premises above ground-floor level.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Oman Tax Authority (Oman Tax Authority) - Tax Management System (TMS) e-portal: https://tms.taxoman.gov.om
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-owned Single Person Company (SPC) must first obtain a Commercial Registration certificate from the Oman Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MOCIIP). The SPC must then apply to the Oman Tax Authority for a Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN/VAT ID) via the TMS online portal. The application requires the Commercial Registration, executed Memorandum/Articles of Association, a board-or-shareholder resolution confirming officers, copies of passports, registered office evidence, and opening financials; the TIN is issued within 5-15 business days.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None. Oman does not operate check-the-box elections or hybrid-mismatch elections; the tax classification of an SPC is fixed by law as a juridical person subject to corporate income tax on its worldwide profits.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: OMR 38,500 annual taxable supplies for mandatory registration; OMR 19,250 for voluntary registration
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time electronic invoicing clearance or digital stamping regime is currently implemented in Oman. Taxpayers may issue invoices via ERP systems compliant with VAT Law format and must file periodic VAT returns electronically through the TMS. The Tax Authority may request digital sales records and transactional data during audits.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of goods to destinations outside the GCC qualify for 0% VAT if evidenced by a customs export declaration. Supplies of services to non-resident recipients located outside Oman may be zero-rated where the benefit is enjoyed outside Oman and the supply meets the requirements of the Oman VAT Law's place-of-supply rules. For digital social-casino and virtual slots content distributed through Apple App Store and Google Play Billing, the operator must demonstrate that the consumer's location is outside Oman and that the digital supply is performed and enjoyed offshore.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Digital Service Delivery Log (for online digital supplies)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The Oman Tax Authority may scrutinize export zero-rating claims, including the actual receipt of foreign currency and the completeness of export documentation. For fraudulent zero-rating or inadequate documentation, the taxpayer may be required to reverse the zero-rated treatment, resulting in an assessment of the undercharged VAT (at the standard 5% rate), plus administrative penalties of up to 3 times the unpaid tax, and criminal sanctions including fines and imprisonment in cases of deliberate evasion.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Oman (CBO), operating under the Omani Banking Law (Royal Decree 114/2000), the Anti-Money Laundering and Combating Terrorism Financing Law (Royal Decree 30/2016), and CBO Circulars on foreign exchange, balance-of-payments (BOP) reporting and bank customer due diligence (CDD). The Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MoCIIP) administers foreign-ownership registration and Commercial Registration (CR); the Oman Tax Authority (OTA) governs tax registration, CIT (15%) clearance, and the related-party documentation required for capital and profit remittances.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Omani Rial (OMR) is freely convertible and pegged to the US Dollar at OM 1 = USD 2.60076 (official mid-rate, maintained within narrow margins). Current-account transactions (digital-content export revenue, platform commissions, royalties, operating expenses) are fully convertible without prior CBO approval for a licensed commercial-bank client. Capital-account flows (share capital injection, shareholder loans, dividend distribution) are also liberal subject to bank-level BOP reporting, AML/CFT screening, supporting corporate documentation, and OTA clearance where applicable. Oman permits 100% foreign ownership of a Single Person Company (SPC) in ISIC 5820 software publishing, imposes no dividend withholding tax, and allows profit remittance once audited financial statements, a valid CR, and OTA/Zakat clearance evidence are presented to the paying bank.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Oman imposes no statutory surrender timeline and no mandatory conversion ratio for export proceeds. The SPC may retain all digital-export receipts in USD/EUR in foreign-currency accounts at licensed banks and may convert at the pegged CBO rate at prevailing commercial bank rates. The receiving bank must tag every inward remittance with the correct BOP purpose code under the IMF BPM6 statistical framework and retain underlying settlement evidence (Apple/Google payout statements, aggregator settlement reports) for CBO reporting; failure to evidence the underlying export service can trigger a BOP-misclassification inquiry and enhanced compliance review.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow / Capital Deposit Account (pre-CR capital certificate issuance) + Operational Account with USD/EUR ancillary foreign-currency accounts
Capital Escrow / Capital Deposit Account + Operational Account (dual OMR/USD product)
Operational Account; SME digital-services account package
Operational Account with cross-border payments focus

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Constrained / Low. Oman does not operate a full non-bank Electronic Money Institution (EMI) licensing regime. Offshore or SEPA-licensed EMIs and virtual banks cannot lawfully hold OMR balances, open Omani bank references, or act as the primary treasury settlement rail for the SPC. The CBO Payment Service Provider framework recognises only locally licensed PSPs/aggregators, so all consumer-platform settlement (Apple IAP, Google Play Billing) must ultimately clear into a CBO-regulated commercial bank account in the SPC's name. Foreign EMIs may be used only as ancillary disbursement or FX-orchestration rails for non-Omani counterparties, subject to full pass-through reconciliation and BOP reporting.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Mandatory as a practical matter. CBO-regulated banks require an in-person KYC interview of the ultimate beneficial owner (UBO), the natural-person director/shareholder, and at least one authorised signatory at onboarding. Remote or video-only onboarding is accepted only on an exceptional, bank-discretionary basis and must be justified in the bank's compliance file, typically where a Muscat-resident corporate-services agent attends with a notarised limited power of attorney and the UBO participates by verified video call. The onboarding blueprint must budget for at least one physical visit to Muscat or a GCC group-office visit, and must present a certified documentary set: CR, capital deposit certificate, apostilled constitutional documents, board resolution, passports, source-of-funds and source-of-wealth file, and a parent-company bank reference.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Social-casino digital revenue flagged as unverifiable e-gaming income without attributable platform settlement records.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: 12-month Apple App Store Connect and Google Play Console payout statements; payment-aggregator settlement reports (Stripe/Adyen/Braintree schema); a legal opinion from Omani counsel classifying the product as simulated social casino (play-money, no real-money gambling, no redemption to cash); consumer Terms of Service and privacy policy; and a platform revenue-flow diagram (consumer IAP to Apple/Google to aggregator to SPC bank account).

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: UBO resident in a higher-risk or non-OECD jurisdiction with insufficient source-of-wealth documentation.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Apostilled passports and proof of address; source-of-wealth statement with corroborating income and asset evidence; 12-month bank reference letters from a qualifying home-country bank; group organisational chart; audited parent-entity financial statements; and a written beneficial-ownership declaration mapped to the SPC register.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident remote signatories and absence of physical execution of bank mandate documents.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarised and apostilled board resolution appointing signatories; specimen signature card attested by a correspondent bank; a CBO-compliant signatory declaration; and a limited power of attorney to a Muscat-licensed corporate-services agent for liaison with bank compliance.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Related-party payables for licensing, royalties, and technology fees treated as potential trade-based money laundering.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed intercompany and licence agreements; written transfer-pricing documentation aligned with Oman transfer-pricing expectations; invoice-to-ledger trace; debt-matching vendor schedule; and a related-party due-diligence pack containing beneficial-ownership KYC for each payee.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Expected high-velocity multi-currency outbound flows disproportionate to stated revenue.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Board-approved annual treasury plan and cash-flow model; Apple/Google payout reconciliation; audited annual financial statements; and a BOP reporting history demonstrating that every inbound and outbound flow carries a coherent business purpose and matching contractual documentation.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: The foreign shareholder wires equity or a shareholder loan via SWIFT MT103 from a qualifying source bank into the SPC's capital escrow account at Bank Muscat or National Bank of Oman. Remittance instructions must state 'Share Capital Contribution' or 'Shareholder Loan' as the purpose and reference the CR number. The receiving bank applies a BPM6 direct-investment code (equity other than investment-fund shares for capital injections; other direct-investment capital for shareholder loans) and requires the capital deposit certificate, a board/shareholder resolution approving the injection, and, for a loan, an executed intercompany loan agreement with arm's-length interest. After the capital certificate is issued, funds are swept to the operational account; no CBO prior approval is required, but the bank files the transaction in the BOP report and may request an amended CR if paid-in capital exceeds the registered amount.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Because ISIC 5820 digital-content publishing is a service business, outbound clearing uses SWIFT MT103 credit transfers (telegraphic transfer) rather than documentary credits; commercial letters of credit are inapplicable. Key streams: (i) platform commissions owed to Apple and Google are netted from payout statements and therefore do not leave the Omani bank account; (ii) royalty and licence payables to overseas licensors are paid by MT103 with invoice, licence contract, and transfer-pricing documentation attached for AML review; (iii) dividend repatriation to the foreign shareholder is executed by MT103 with audited financial statements, OTA tax-clearance certificate, Zakat clearance where triggered, and the BPM6 dividend purpose code; and (iv) cloud, SaaS, hosting, and marketing vendor payments are executed by MT103 or, for recurrent low-value flows, through the bank's MT101 electronic instruction and SWIFT gpi payment services. The bank will enforce dual-authorisation controls and reject payments to sanctioned entities.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable vanilla FX forwards (OMR/USD at pegged parity; OMR/EUR; OMR/GBP) for bona-fide commercial exposure under an ISDA or IFEMA master agreement with a CBO-licensed bank; speculative hedging is prohibited
FX swaps (OMR against foreign currency, and USD/EUR/GBP cross-currency swaps) to rebalance treasury liquidity without creating unhedged positions
OTC vanilla FX options (call and put structures) for covered hedging of projected Apple/Google receivables, subject to bank product approval and CBO anti-speculation policy
Cross-currency interest-rate swaps on shareholder-loan liabilities (USD/EUR floating-to-fixed) where the underlying exposure is documented and non-speculative

OMR NDFs: not available and not permissible because the OMR/USD parity is a fixed CBO-administered peg with a fully deliverable market; hedging must be executed through deliverable forwards or by naturalising treasury balances in USD

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MoCIIP) – Commercial Registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on or before the expiry date shown on the Commercial Registration certificate (anniversary of the initial registration date)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late renewal attracts a penalty of OMR 20 (USD 52) per month or part thereof; operating with an expired CR is an offence and, after three months of lapse, the entity is subject to administrative strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Audited Annual Financial Statements and Annual List of Members
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within six months of the end of the financial year (for a calendar year, by no later than 30 June)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file for two consecutive financial years leads to a warning and administrative dissolution; responsible officers are liable to fines of OMR 1,000–5,000 (USD 2,600–13,000).

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within four months of the end of the tax year (if the tax year is the calendar year, by no later than 30 April)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing incurs a penalty of 10% of the tax due immediately after the deadline, plus an additional 1% per month of delay; a 25% penalty applies after six months and criminal action may be pursued for tax evasion.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Oman Chamber of Commerce and Industry Membership Renewal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Oman Chamber of Commerce and Industry (OCCI)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually, aligned with the Commercial Registration renewal cycle
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-renewal prevents access to customs clearance, import/export privileges and government tenders; continuous non-renewal for six months results in suspension of OCCI membership.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Under the Oman Commercial Companies Law (Royal Decree 18/2019), every company regardless of size, turnover, or shareholder count must appoint a licensed auditor and undergo an annual independent statutory audit. No exemption exists for a Single Person Company.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) as issued by the IASB and adopted in Oman; no alternative local GAAP is permitted for companies incorporated under the Commercial Companies Law.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: A Single Person Company must maintain a Register of Beneficial Owners at its registered office. Every change in direct or indirect ownership or beneficial control, including any transfer of shares, must be reported to the MoCIIP Commercial Registry within 30 days of the change. The annual Commercial Registration renewal serves as the recurring confirmation that the UBO register is accurate and up-to-date; no separate annual UBO declaration is required unless a change has occurred. Non-reporting is punishable by fines of OMR 1,000–10,000 (USD 2,600–26,000).

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 800 – 2,000 per annum for registered office, PO Box and local commercial agency services in Muscat
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 1,000 – 3,000 per annum for a low-volume digital publishing SPC; the audit fee scales with the number of payment gateways, transaction volume and complexity of app-revenue recognition

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 15% (standard corporate income tax rate under Oman's unified Income Tax Law, Royal Decree 39/2024, applying to tax years beginning on or after 1 January 2025)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Qualifying small taxpayers (annual gross revenue not exceeding OMR 100,000) pay 0% on the first OMR 10,000 of taxable income; no general sector-specific holiday applies to ISIC 5820 digital publishing; dividends distributed from already-taxed profits are not subject to further Oman corporate tax; R&D payroll and certified training expenditures remain deductible subject to anti-avoidance ceilings

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form CIT-1 (Annual Corporate Income Tax Return) filed electronically through the EMTAAT portal (emtaat.taxoman.gov.om) operated by the Oman Tax Authority; registration requires the SPC's Commercial Registration certificate and Tax Identification Number (TIN)
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual (one return per fiscal year; the default taxable year is the Gregorian calendar year for an SPC incorporated before 31 March, unless the Tax Authority approves an alternative accounting period)
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 4 calendar months after the close of the taxable year: for a 31 December year-end the return and full self-assessed tax payment are due by 30 April; no extension is available for the payment, with abatement possible only in justified hardship cases

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxpayer identity: SPC legal name, Commercial Register No., TIN, fiscal year, address, registered agent email
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The SPC is an Omani-resident juridical person; the foreign 100% shareholder is identified in the Beneficial Ownership Annexure but files no separate Oman return for the SPC's income

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross revenue: total invoiced and collected consideration from Apple IAP and Google Play Billing for simulated slots and social casino products (before platform commissions)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report gross proceeds transiting Apple/Google wallets attributed to Oman-sourced player activity; diverted offshore collection accounts remain Omani-source income of the SPC

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Cost of sales: App Store/Google Play handling fees (15% standard / 30% small-business commission), cloud hosting and bandwidth, third-party game engine licensing
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Foreign platform fees are deductible if supported by monthly statements; payments for hosted services must be examined for services-rendered-in-Oman WHT exposure

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Intercompany and royalty adjustments: royalties, trademarks, software licenses and management fees paid to non-resident group companies
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Such payments require arm's-length benchmarking (OECD CUP/TNMM) and are subject to 10% withholding tax absent claimable treaty relief; under-documented payments must be added back

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Add-backs and disallowances: personal expenses of directors, unsubstantiated entertainment, penalties, interest on unpaid tax, excessive marketing sub-commissions
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident parent recharges lacking an underlying contract or economic benefit are added back; deemed-dividend treatment applies to disguised profit remittances

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax loss relief: losses brought forward from prior years, limited to 5 consecutive years and to the same category of activity with continuity of ownership
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A foreign-owned SPC must prove continuity of the gaming activity; change of control above 50% during the loss year voids the carryforward unless the Tax Authority consents

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax computation: taxable income after loss relief; application of the 0% SME band (first OMR 10,000) and 15% on the remainder; credit for foreign tax and advance installments
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The 0% SME band is unavailable to non-resident branches; the SPC qualifies only if annual gross revenue is within the OMR 100,000 ceiling

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Electronic signature by the SPC manager/director and certification by the licensed tax agent/auditor attaching audited financial statements
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The foreign shareholder's nominee director executing the declaration accepts joint criminal liability for wilful false statements

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: administrative fine up to OMR 5,000 plus a recurring monthly surcharge of 1% of the unpaid tax (capped at 25%); late payment carries interest at the statutory rate; filing a materially false return exposes the SPC to a penalty of 50%-100% of the under-charged tax and criminal prosecution
